Themes

- butter (example, @astryxdesign/cli)
  Warm, creamy yellows with a friendly blue accent. Playful enough for consumer surfaces, soft enough to stay readable.

- chocolate (example, @astryxdesign/cli)
  Warm chocolate theme for Astryx - rich brown palette with Fraunces headings, Albert Sans body, and Lucide icons

- gothic (example, @astryxdesign/cli)
  Deep blue-grays and a signature display serif. Dramatic and editorial, for surfaces that want to be remembered.

- matcha (example, @astryxdesign/cli)
  Earthy greens with a calm, organic feel. Naturalistic and grounded, great for wellness or content-first apps.

- neutral (maintained, @astryxdesign/cli)
  Restrained warm grays. Minimal and quiet, so the content stays the focus.

- stone (example, @astryxdesign/cli)
  Warm stone and slate, earthy and understated, with just enough character to feel handcrafted.

- y2k (example, @astryxdesign/cli)
  Hot pinks, lime greens, and Poppins. Bubbly, playful, and unmistakably retro.

- ocean (maintained, @acme/kit)
  A zorblax blue.

Import one: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme add <slug> [--package <package>]
Fork source: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme eject <slug> [target-path]

More themes in packages you could add: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 discover theme
